subject: Re: Kickoff: mucped22 — staffing + tooling plan
body:
Hi Lucia,

Plan:

- Gustavo Moreau 50% owns ingestion and the metric-correlation baselines; Ondrej Bergstrom 40% designs the rating methodology (rater qualification, session length, pair sampling) so we don't recreate the crowdsourcing weaknesses the release critiques.
- Since nothing suitable exists in-house, we're building a human-rating annotation UI from scratch — Emeka Pinto owns it at 50% (pairwise comparison views, rater qualification flow, session quality checks), roughly seven weeks of work for a v1 we can run study batches through.
- Compute: negligible; this is a data and tooling project. Storage ask to Corpus for the image sets is in.

Budget note: expert raters aren't free — Ondrej estimates ~$18k for the April pilot batch at the session lengths he wants. I'd rather pay for experienced raters than re-import the exact problem this dataset exists to fix.

Bruno
